title: Local Characterization of a Machine Step
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be an input, let $s\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $C$ be a configuration on $x$ whose work-tape heads lie within distance $s$ of the origin and whose tape contents vanish outside that window. Let $a$ be an action and let $v$ be a list of optional cell values of length $2s+1$. The condition that, at every position $i<2s+3$, the padded list of values in $v$ agrees with the local update rule determined by $a$ and the three corresponding padded cells of the encoding of $C$ is equivalent to both of the following: each entry of $v$ is the encoded cell of the configuration obtained by applying $a$ to $C$, and that resulting configuration has all work-tape heads and nonblank contents within the same window of radius $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$C$ has every work-tape head within radius $s$
$C$ has no nonblank tape contents outside radius $s$
$v$ is a list of optional cell values
